bm_desc: Inter-alia to consider and approve the Un-audited financial results of the Company for the Third quarter ended December 31, 2011 and interim dividend, if any.

The Company has informed the Exchange that the next meeting of the Board of Directors will be held from January 18, 2012 to January 20, 2012. The Board of Directors will consider and approve, inter-alia : (1) Audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2011. The accounts would be finally approved by the Board of Directors only on January 20 ,2012 (Morning); (2) Consideration of proposed interim dividend.

To consider inter alia : (1) The audited financial results of the Company for the third quarter and nine months ending December 31, 2011; (2) The audited consolidated financial results of the Company and its subsidiaries for the third quarter and nine months ending December 31, 2011.
